fixtures.preview: Anfield hosts the biggest rivalry in English football (4:30pm UK, 3:30am Mon 23 Nov Sydney), with United coming off a wild 4-4 draw with Aston Villa.
talking_points: United drew 4-4 at home to Aston Villa on Sunday 8 Nov, per Sky Sports' fixtures page.
They beat Roma 3-2 in the Champions League on 3 Nov, so results have swung wildly.
Dorgu, Shaw and Baleba have all had injury problems this season; who is fit for Anfield isn't confirmed.
Team news is unconfirmed until closer to kick-off.

fixtures.preview: Matchday 5 in Lisbon, with United needing a result to stay in the top-eight race (8pm UK, 7am Thu 26 Nov Sydney).
Brentford visit Old Trafford on Saturday 28 Nov at 3pm UK time (2am Sun 29 Nov Sydney).
A Wednesday-night trip to Tyneside at 8pm UK time (7am Thu 3 Dec Sydney); all fixtures are subject to change.
Newly promoted Coventry visit Old Trafford on Saturday 5 Dec at 3pm UK time (2am Sun 6 Dec Sydney).
Sydney travel to Brisbane (6:40pm Brisbane time, 7:40pm Sydney) after a 4-1 home win over Central Coast.
talking_points: Al Hassan Toure hit a hat-trick in the 4-1 win over the Mariners, and Gabriel Popovic scored his first goal for the club.
Coach Patrick Kisnorbo said 'the best is yet to come' after that win.
Loan signing Jacob Farrell was named in the extended squad and may debut; the squad for Brisbane isn't confirmed.
No injury list was found this run, so availability is unconfirmed.

notes: Search and fetch coverage was thin this run: many club, venue, ticketing and supermarket pages blocked access, so some details come from search results and third-party listings.
Man Utd: fixtures and the 4-4 Villa result come from Sky Sports. Team news for Anfield is unconfirmed. Stan Sport as broadcaster rests on existing rights and was not re-confirmed per match.
Sydney FC: talking points come from the club news page. No fresh injury list or ladder position was found. The Auckland kick-off is treated as New Zealand time.

Big matches: carried over from the previous run; Champions League kick-offs use UEFA's default 21:00 CET and broadcasters were not re-confirmed. The Jordan v Socceroos friendly (17 Nov local) has no confirmed time, so it isn't listed.

Local: no local news from the last 7 days was found. School events come from the Term 4 calendar and Week 4 Principal Update (dates may change); nothing was found for the second school or South Eveleigh.
Live sport: the Kings v Breakers game (15 Nov) could not be re-opened this run, so check the time before going. No Sydney tennis, rugby union or Matildas games were found.

Arts: Robbie Williams, Silver Tongue, Whispering Jack, Men I Trust, Wolf Alice, Iron Maiden, Death Cab prices and the exhibitions were carried from the previous run and not fully re-opened. Boyz II Men (4 Dec) is sold out.
Son and daughter: nothing found for Sydney Pokémon, Minecraft or Roblox events, a junior parkrun near home, matcha pop-ups in the window, or kids' author events.
Groceries: half-price lines come from an OzBargain roundup of the 11-17 Nov catalogues; no half-price fruit, veg, eggs or nuts were listed. Aldi items have no was-price.
